mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,a.program_type,a.system_code,sys.short_name AS system_short_name,sys.name AS system_name,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.program_description,a.owner_id,a.created_by,a.created_at,a.updated_by,a.updated_at

a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,'SCRIPT' AS asset_type,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.program_type,a.system_code,sys.short_name AS system_short_name,sys.name AS system_name,a.program_description,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at

FROM dm_script a LEFT JOIN dm_component c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.project_id=a.project_id AND c.system_code=a.system_code LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem sys ON sys.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND sys.code=c.system_code AND sys.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0
WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=0 AND a.program_type=#{programType} AND a.system_code=#{systemCode} AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_script SET doc_name=#{p.docName},program_type=#{p.programType},system_code=#{p.systemCode},program_description=#{p.programDescription},updated_by=#{p.updatedBy},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_script SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{deletedBy},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment m JOIN dm_script a ON a.id=m.business_id AND a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.business_type='SCRIPT' AND m.business_id=#{id} AND m.deleted=0 AND a.deleted=0 ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC,m.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_script a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=1 AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=1 AND a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY a.doc_code ASC,a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=1
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_script SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_script WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND enabled=1
SELECT id,project_id,program_type,system_code,doc_code,doc_name,program_description,owner_id FROM dm_script WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
SELECT project_id FROM dm_script WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
